offers_products.reason: Sells smart meters, endpoints, network devices and software to utilities.

offers_services.reason: Offers managed services, deployment and implementation of its networks and software for utilities and cities.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Customers are utilities and cities, not households.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Utilities and cities buy its meters, networks and software.

recurring_revenue.reason: Largely meter and network deployment projects; recurring software and services are a smaller part, though meaningful.

cyclical_demand.reason: Utilities spend on metering and grid reliability is regulated and essential, so it is less discretionary.

big_ticket.reason: Utility-wide AMI network and meter deployments are large, infrequent multi-year purchases.

people_delivered.reason: Customers mainly pay for devices, networks and software, not staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are large utilities such as PG&E and SMUD, plus municipalities.

asset_heavy.reason: Designs devices and software, largely using contract manufacturers; no fleets or networks of its own.

notes: Recurring revenue and asset intensity are judgment calls; the website text gives no revenue mix.
